ThingDef.Name: WA_Seat_ZabutonBase
ThingDef.label: Zabuton
ThingDef.description:
The cushion contains cotton etc. as a cushioning material in a cloth bag and is used for sitting on tatami mats and floor.
 Elasticity as much as Namba cushion is not required and the main purpose is to prevent body temperature from being deprived to the floor.
 It was made around the Kamakura period, originally used as a symbol of power of authority and high priest.
 It is said that middle people of the Edo period spread widely among ordinary people.
 It is a design which was originally completed, and it is widely used even now.
